title: 184 rotten doc references are permanently green behind a 27-entry baseline

first_order.what_broke: The founder opened the docs bundle and hit a document describing an architecture that has since changed. scripts/doc_lint.py already detects this class and reports 184 findings, none of which fail CI.
first_order.receipt: .venv/bin/python scripts/doc_lint.py --json returns 184 findings on 2026-08-18: 173 missing_path, 9 retired_provider, 2 empty_path. Worst files: docs/OPS_CONSOLE_PROGRAM.md 29, docs/COMMERCIAL_READINESS_PROGRAM.md 15, docs/LAUNCH_OPS_PROGRAM.md 14.

cause_chain: docs/doc_lint_baseline.json holds 27 entries and check_ratchet only fails on a regression against that baseline, so the other 157 findings never fail anything.
The gate was installed with the existing rot grandfathered in, and nothing was scheduled to burn the baseline down, so grandfathered became permanent.

Nothing measures whether a doc's claims still match the live estate. Commit age does not measure it: no doc on origin/main is more than 4 days old and docs/ENGINE_AUDIT_2026-08-10.md was touched 3 days ago and is still wrong.
CLASS: a ratchet with no burn-down schedule is a warning fence, and a warning fence is not a fence.

second_order.note: NOT YET RUN. Other ratchets almost certainly exist and this record cannot close until the sweep has a number.
